fields.label: Loop Opened
fields.help: Single = one task/question to one person. Double = two to one person. Multiple = more than two to one person. Two tasks to two different people are two separate call-outs.

fields.label: Call Out Direction
fields.help: Name/Title if the initiator included someone's name or title; otherwise Undirected.

fields.label: Intended/Assumed Recipient
fields.help: Directed: the named recipient. Undirected: the assumed recipient; Unspecified (group) if aimed at the group, Unknown if it can't be assumed.

fields.label: Loop Content Domain
fields.help: A question is Information Seeking. A task is Task Direction; pick the corresponding task.

fields.label: Verbal Check Back (timestamp)
fields.help: For double/multiple loops, add every check back to the same loop, each with its own timestamp.

lists.label: Information Check Back
lists.help: Info seeking: the answer to the question. Task: the recipient acknowledging the request.

lists.label: Task Completion Check Back
lists.help: Recipient acknowledging they completed the task. Never present for information-seeking call-outs.

fields.label: Task Completion
fields.help: Use check backs and other cues (e.g. hearing CPR being performed). For information seeking, Full if the question was answered.

fields.label: Loop Closure (timestamp)
fields.help: The initiator acknowledging receipt of the check back. Double/multiple loops: one entry per closure.

fields.label: Notes
fields.help: Characteristic features of the call-out, using the glossary.

rules.message: Information-seeking call-outs don't have a Task Completion Check Back.
Information-seeking call-out was answered (has an Information Check Back), so Task Completion should be Full.
A directed (Name/Title) call-out should have a specific recipient, not Unspecified (group) or Unknown.
Loop Closure is the initiator acknowledging a check back, but there is no Verbal Check Back.
Single loop has more than one Task Completion Check Back. Should this be a Double/Multiple loop?
